definitions.full: H3039. yadid [ יָדִיד ] adjective (poetry) beloved (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic ) — construct יְדִיד Deut 33:12 ; suffix לִידִידִי Isa 5:1 (twice in verse); Jer 11:15 ; לִידִידוֺ Psa 127:2 ; plural suffix יְדִידֶיךָ 60:7 ; 108:7 ; feminine יְדִידֹת 45:1 ; יְדִידוֺת 84:2 ; — 1 my beloved , used by prophets of ׳י under figure of husbandman Isa 5:1 (twice in verse); so my (thy, his) beloved Jer 11:15 ; Psa 60:7 = 108:7 Psalm 2; beloved , of Benjamin as beloved by ׳י Deut 33:12 . 2 lovely , מִשְׁכְּנוֺתֶיךָ מַהיְּֿדִידוֺת Psa 84:2 how lovely are thy habitations ! 3 feminine plural as abstract substantive יְדִידֹת שִׁיר Psa 45:1 = a song of love .
